name: Craftsman's Writ: Colorful Kilt
summary: A customer requests a Colorful Kilt through a transferable writ. The garment is meant to help the customer blend in at Zul'Gurub.

sections.title: A disguise
sections.body: The writ asks you to provide one Colorful Kilt and bring it to the marked location. The customer plans to sneak through Zul'Gurub's gates dressed like one of its ritualists, and says the kilt suits that disguise.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Colorful Kilt, to be delivered to the location marked on your map.

faq.q: Why does the customer want a colorful kilt?
faq.answer: The customer plans to sneak into Zul'Gurub dressed like one of its ritualists and says the kilt will help.
Yes. The writ says it is transferable.

faq.q: Where should I deliver the kilt?
faq.answer: The writ directs you to the location marked on your map.
